physics_goals.value: Measure the neutrino mixing angle theta_13 via reactor antineutrino disappearance using near and far identical detectors
physics_goals.quote: The RENO experiment has observed the disappearance of reactor electron antineutrinos, consistent with neutrino oscillations, with a significance of 4.9 standard deviations.

summary.plain: A South Korean experiment with two identical detectors near and far from a group of six nuclear reactors, which observed antineutrinos disappearing exactly as neutrino oscillation theory predicts.
summary.technical: Reactor-antineutrino oscillation experiment at the Hanbit (Yonggwang) Nuclear Power Plant, Korea, with identical near (294 m) and far (1383 m) detectors from a 6 x 2.8 GW_th reactor array. Its 2012 result observed reactor antineutrino disappearance at 4.9σ, sin²(2θ₁₃)=0.113±0.013(stat)±0.019(syst).
